title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 6:5-15
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 6:5-15</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="5" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">when you pray</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">don’t</char> be <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">like the hypocrites</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because they</char> love to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">pray</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">while standing in the gathering places and at the corners of wide streets</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">for the purpose of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">being visible to people</char>. 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          Truly, I tell you: They have fully received their <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">reward</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="6" /> But <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">you, when you pray</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">enter into your inner-room and shut the door</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">so</char> you can <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">pray</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">in hiddenness</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
          and <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">your Father</char>, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">who sees</char> what is <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">in hiddenness</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3">
          he will fully <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">reward</char> you. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
          <verse number="7" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">when you are praying</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">don’t</char> use meaningless repetition <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">like the nations</char>, 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">because they</char> suppose 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">that they’ll be heard on account of their many words</char>. 
        </group>
        <optbreak />
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c''">
          <verse number="8" /> So don’t be like them, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3">
          because <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father</char> knows what you need 
        </group>
        <group indent="3">
          before you even ask him. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="9" /> Therefore, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">when you pray</char>, do it this way: 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">Our Father</char> who is <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="blue">in the skies</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">may your</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">name</char> be recognized as sacred,
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <verse number="10" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">may your</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">kingdom</char> come,
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">and may your</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">will</char> be done, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        as it is <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="blue">in the skies</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        so also <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="blue">on the land</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="11" /> Our daily provision of bread, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        give to us today. 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="12" /> And forgive us our debts, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        just as we also have forgiven those indebted to us. 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a''">
        <verse number="13" /> And don’t lead us to be tested, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b''">
        but deliver us from the evil one. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="14" /> For if you <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">forgive</char> people their transgressions, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father in the skies</char> will also <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">forgive</char> you. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="15" /> But if you will not <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">forgive</char> people, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        then neither will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">your Father</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">forgive</char> your transgressions. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
